query_text: Create a ranked horizontal bar chart for the top 8 countries by sampled innovations per visible Top-50 city in the 2021 report, where the metric is `total sampled innovations / number of visible cities ranked 50th or better`, values are expressed as sampled innovations per Top-50 city, countries must have at least one visible Top-50 city, Canada and Sweden are excluded because of city-rank conflicts, and bars are sorted from highest to lowest after the ratio is derived.
selection_rule: top 8 after at least one visible Top-50 city and excluding Canada/Sweden
